SPOR

240minutes
72solder joints
difficulty

OnStepX GoTo controller for the mount you already own

Heat the pad and the pin together for two seconds. Feed solder into the joint, not onto the iron. Take the solder away first, then the iron.

Strip 3 mm, twist the strands, and tin the end before you solder it to a pad.

Unplug USB and disconnect any battery before you solder or change a wire. Work on a surface that does not burn, and wash your hands after handling solder.

23SPOR-WIRE-1

Before you switch it on

  1. Look. Every joint is a shiny cone. No solder touches a neighbouring pad. No stray strands of wire.
  2. These must not beep. Set the multimeter to continuity and probe each pair. A beep means a short: find it before you plug in.
    V12GNDV5_REGGNDV5GND3V3GND
  3. These must beep. Probe the two ends of every connection.
    V1212 V socket + · 5 V regulator VIN · 100 uF capacitor + · RA driver VM · Dec driver VM
    GND12 V socket - · 5 V regulator GND · Controller GND · 100 uF capacitor - · RA driver GND · Dec driver GND · RA driver GND.2 · Dec driver GND.2 · Limit switch COM
    V5_REG5 V regulator VOUT · Diode A
    V5Diode K · Controller 5V
    3V3Controller 3V3 · RA driver VIO · Dec driver VIO · Dec driver MS1
    AXIS_ENController IO5 · RA driver EN · Dec driver EN
    AXIS1_STEPController IO18 · RA driver STEP
    AXIS1_DIRController IO0 · RA driver DIR
    AXIS2_STEPController IO27 · Dec driver STEP
    AXIS2_DIRController IO26 · Dec driver DIR
    TMC_TXController IO4 · UART 1k 1
    TMC_UARTUART 1k 2 · RA driver UART · Dec driver UART · Controller VN
    LIMIT_SENSEController IO23 · Limit switch NC
    ra_A1RA driver A1 · RA socket 1
    ra_A2RA driver A2 · RA socket 2
    ra_B1RA driver B1 · RA socket 3
    ra_B2RA driver B2 · RA socket 4
    dec_A1Dec driver A1 · Dec socket 1
    dec_A2Dec driver A2 · Dec socket 2
    dec_B1Dec driver B1 · Dec socket 3
    dec_B2Dec driver B2 · Dec socket 4
  4. Plug in. Nothing gets warm, nothing smells. If something does, unplug at once and go back to step 2.
  5. Flash the bring-up test. It reports every part it can find before you load the real firmware.pio run -e bringup -t upload && pio device monitor
24SPOR-WIRE-1

Spor is built

Spor is the electronics half of an OnStep retrofit: an ESP32 and two TMC2209 drivers wired to the OnStepX MaxESP4 pin map, in a printed box with a 12 V socket, two motor leads and a limit switch input. It is for someone adding tracking and GoTo to an existing equatorial or alt-az mount, who will make the motor brackets for that mount themselves.
